about: Shared fixture for the [http.causes] shape rule (M6-F2, SPEC §22.2 (cy)). Each case is a whole causes table and whether the rule accepts it. Run against the Rust rule (ferro-proto tests/registry_sync.rs, which build.rs and the registry parser share via include!) AND against proto/tools/gen-php.php (php/client tests/Conformance/HttpCausesShapeRuleTest.php), so the implementations cannot disagree.

cases.why: a leading digit (not a Rust identifier; PHP json_decode would also turn the key into an int)
a trailing newline (PHP's $ matches before one without the D modifier)
the key is not the token upper-cased
one bad entry among good ones
